Body.Content:
Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time

GA date: November CY2026

Preview date: November CY2026
